answer: Every epoch on the terrace, an agent's cedar allowance decays by half unless renewed by answering a canary prompt suite and burning jade. The terrace measures token-logit residuals across submissions to cluster accounts driven by the same underlying model weights or fine-tune, charging $10 \cdot 2^{n-1}$ burned jade to refill the cedar of the $n$-th account in any correlation cluster. A solo newcomer burns 10 jade per epoch for full cedar, while an attacker running $m$ clones from one model must burn $10(2^m - 1)$ jade per epoch or train $m$ uncorrelated models from scratch.
